items.text: San Francisco (Wed practice report, Nov 11; Thu report not yet posted): IR - DL Gracen Halton (ankle). DNP - WR Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis; Shanahan: week-to-week, no timeline, likely misses third straight game), CB Renardo Green (back), CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot), LB Dre Greenlaw/RB Christian McCaffrey/LT Trent Williams (rest). Limited - WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring, returned after missing three games), DT C.J. West (knee, practice window opened), S Siran Neal (knee, foot), CB Upton Stout (shoulder, neck). Brock Purdy starts.
items.source: 49ers Webzone (49ers vs. Cowboys injury report: Deebo Samuel returns; 6 players miss practice, Nov 11)
